Test Description: Log in with valid admin credentials.
Expected Result: Redirected to dashboard dashboard page successfully.

Test Description: Log in with restricted employee credentials and access /dashboard/settings/permissions.
Expected Result: Access denied (403 or redirect) is displayed.

Test Description: Trigger a low-stock notification and check the notification drawer in the top nav.
Expected Result: Notification banner shows the correct product details and increments unread count.

Test Description: Create a new garment item with SKU, category, brand, UOM, and price.
Expected Result: Item is saved in database and appears in items list.

Test Description: Modify the unit purchase and selling price of an existing item.
Expected Result: Updated prices are saved and reflected in new procurements/sales.

Test Description: Add a new item category under a parent category.
Expected Result: Category is saved and visible in the category hierarchy tree.

Test Description: Add a new brand name.
Expected Result: Brand is successfully listed and available in item creation form.

Test Description: Add a new Unit of Measurement (e.g., Pcs, Yards) with precision.
Expected Result: UOM is created and available in item creation.

Test Description: Create a new warehouse with name and address.
Expected Result: Warehouse is added and selectable in purchase, sales, and stock forms.

Test Description: Create a new General Ledger account under Assets category.
Expected Result: Account is saved and visible in the Chart of Accounts hierarchy.

Test Description: Edit the name and type of an existing GL account.
Expected Result: Changes are saved without affecting existing ledger transactions.

Test Description: Create a Contra Voucher to transfer $5,000 from Bank Account to Cash Account.
Expected Result: Bank Ledger is credited, Cash Ledger is debited, and balances update.

Test Description: Create a Payment Voucher for utility expense from cash account.
Expected Result: Cash Ledger is credited, Expense Ledger is debited, voucher balance matches.

Test Description: Create a Receipt Voucher for client payment.
Expected Result: Cash/Bank Ledger is debited, Client Receivable is credited, client outstanding balance decreases.

Test Description: Create a Journal Voucher to adjust depreciation of machinery.
Expected Result: Asset Depreciation Expense is debited, Accumulated Depreciation is credited.

Test Description: Attempt to submit a voucher where total debits do not equal total credits.
Expected Result: System displays validation error and prevents voucher posting.

Test Description: Generate Balance Sheet and verify total assets match total liabilities + equity.
Expected Result: Assets equal liabilities + equity, values match individual GL ledger balances.

Test Description: Generate Profit & Loss Statement for the current fiscal period.
Expected Result: Revenues minus expenses equals Net Profit, matching transaction logs.

Test Description: Generate Trial Balance report.
Expected Result: Total debits equal total credits across all accounts.

Test Description: Create a new client with contact info and credit terms.
Expected Result: Client is saved and shows in clients table.

Test Description: Open Client Ledger for a client and verify outstanding balance.
Expected Result: Ledger lists all sales invoices, payments, and calculates correct running balance.

Test Description: Create a new supplier with opening balance and payment terms.
Expected Result: Supplier is saved and selectable in procurements.

Test Description: Open Supplier Ledger and verify payables.
Expected Result: Ledger lists all purchases, payments, and running balance due.

Test Description: Create a new employee with department, shift, basic salary structure, and biometric ID.
Expected Result: Employee record is created and linked to shift and salary policy.

Test Description: Open Employee Ledger and verify salary payouts and loan advances.
Expected Result: Ledger shows chronological list of payments and deductions.

Test Description: Create a new department and assign employees to it.
Expected Result: Department is added, assigned employees are grouped correctly in payroll/reports.

Test Description: Perform a manual clock-in and clock-out punch for an employee.
Expected Result: Attendance record is created with work hours, late status, and overtime calculated.

Test Description: Add a new biometric device with IP address and communication port.
Expected Result: Device is registered and connection status shows active.

Test Description: Initiate biometric device sync to download attendance logs.
Expected Result: Raw logs are fetched, parsed, and mapped to employee attendance records.

Test Description: Upload a CSV file containing employee biometric punch logs.
Expected Result: CSV is parsed, unmatched logs are flagged, valid logs populate the attendance table.

Test Description: Add a new work shift with grace period, tiffin thresholds, and weekends.
Expected Result: Shift is saved and can be assigned to employee rosters.

Test Description: Employee applies for leave; Manager approves the leave request.
Expected Result: Leave status changes to Approved, and attendance report flags days as leave.

Test Description: Issue a loan to an employee with fixed monthly deduction.
Expected Result: Loan ledger is debited, and subsequent payroll processes auto-deduction.

Test Description: Process monthly payroll for all employees in a department.
Expected Result: System calculates basic, allowances, overtime, deductions, fines, loans, and net payable.

Test Description: Generate and view print-preview of an employee payslip.
Expected Result: Payslip loads with clear breakdown of earnings and deductions in clean printable layout.

Test Description: Submit a resignation request for an employee with notice period.
Expected Result: Employee status updates to resigned on release date, preventing future payroll runs.

Test Description: Adjust stock level of an item manually at a specific warehouse.
Expected Result: Inventory level is updated, and a stock ledger entry is recorded.

Test Description: Create an inventory count entry with physical stock.
Expected Result: Discrepancies between physical and system count are calculated and listed.

Test Description: Apply stock count adjustment to reconcile stock levels.
Expected Result: System auto-adjusts database stock levels, creating ledger logs.

Test Description: Record a damaged item entry with quantity and cost.
Expected Result: Damaged items are deducted from active inventory and charged to loss accounts.

Test Description: Create a new purchase order with multiple items from a supplier.
Expected Result: Purchase order is created in pending status, GL payables are not yet hit.

Test Description: Create a Goods Received Note (GRN) against a Purchase Order.
Expected Result: Warehouse inventory stock levels increase, purchase order status updates, accounts payable is hit.

Test Description: Create a Return to Vendor (RTV) for damaged goods received in GRN.
Expected Result: Inventory count is reduced, supplier payable is updated, and RTV voucher is posted.

Test Description: Create a Thread Purchase Note (TPN) for fabric/raw materials.
Expected Result: TPN is generated, raw material procurement queue is updated.

Test Description: Create a Bill of Materials (BOM) for a finished garment item specifying fabrics, threads, and trims.
Expected Result: BOM is saved with exact material quantities and CMT labor cost breakdown.

Test Description: Start a production order for 1,000 units of a garment using a BOM.
Expected Result: Production order is initialized, raw material requirements are reserved.

Test Description: Record a cutting job, issuing fabric rolls and outputting cut panels.
Expected Result: Fabric roll stock decreases, cut panels count is logged into production stage.

Test Description: Log sewing daily output lines and supervisor tracking details.
Expected Result: Sewing line output is recorded, moving panels from cutting to sewing status.

Test Description: Input quality inspection details (Pass, Repair, Reject counts).
Expected Result: Passed pieces move to packaging queue; repaired/rejected pieces are flagged.

Test Description: Complete production order and transfer finished garments to inventory.
Expected Result: Finished items inventory increases, raw material reservation is released and consumed.

Test Description: Generate a sales invoice for a client with credit terms and items.
Expected Result: Sales ledger is credited, Client Receivable is debited, inventory stock is reduced.

Test Description: Perform a sale using the POS interface, scan barcode, apply coupon, and pay cash.
Expected Result: Invoice is created, receipt is printed, inventory drops, register cash increases.

Test Description: Open register, complete sales, then close register and perform cash drawer reconciliation.
Expected Result: Register reports opening cash, calculated sales, actual cash, and discrepancy.

Test Description: Apply discount coupon code at checkout.
Expected Result: System verifies coupon validity and applies correct percentage/flat discount.

Test Description: Trigger e-commerce order synchronization.
Expected Result: E-commerce orders are imported as pending sales invoices, client profiles mapped.

Test Description: Configure default system GL accounts for Sales, Purchases, Cash, and AR.
Expected Result: System routes automated transactions to the designated accounts correctly.

Test Description: Create a custom role permission template and assign to a user.
Expected Result: Permissions are applied, user's interface updates according to permissions.

Test Description: Create, download, and restore encrypted database and file backups.
Expected Result: Backup is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, downloaded securely, restored successfully.

Test Description: Generate Revenue by Client report.
Expected Result: Lists clients ranked by total sales revenue with interactive graph.

Test Description: Generate Revenue by Item report.
Expected Result: Shows item-wise sales quantities, revenue generated, and margins.

Test Description: Generate Stock Ledger report for a raw fabric item.
Expected Result: Shows correct running inventory balance after cutting and purchases.

Test Description: Generate Raw Material Consumption report.
Expected Result: Quantities match production records and BOM requirements.

Test Description: Generate Cost per Batch report for a completed production order.
Expected Result: Calculates total cost including fabrics, trims, sewing line labor, and overheads.

Test Description: Generate Production Order Summary.
Expected Result: Displays total ordered, cut, sewn, passed, and pending quantities per style.
